shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a red shirt sits in the plant-side aisle seat and tells a puzzling story, a woman in a green shirt sits in the counter-side aisle seat, a man in an orange shirt sits in the plant-side window seat, and a man in a white shirt sits in the counter-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt leaves her seat and exits the venue, while a woman in a red shirt asks about the contradiction in the story.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt explains the contradiction in the story.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the plant-side aisle seat.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt answers with an explanation, and a woman in a red shirt replies with another question.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the rectangular table.
